# Ryan / Scott
Date: 2026-11-18 | Duration: 33m

## Summary
The team reviewed hiring progress, including a December BDR start in Nashville and an Atlanta sales-engineer interview. Home Depot advanced to pricing after demos, with a three-year proposal exceeding $1 million, a January POC target, and a Q1 decision expected. UPS formally began its RFP, with evaluation and POC activity expected across January and February and product readiness required to compete with Adobe Target. Q4 pipeline coverage was almost 4.7x against a $500,000 forecast; Expedia selected GrowthBook, SBF signature was expected, Washington Post entered procurement, and Zalando delayed its renewal while considering Databricks. OLEX slowed after a completed POC, while CarGurus needed an early POC and parallel procurement to support a Q1 decision. Natera had three live experiments and targeted year-end selection. Inbound lead volume was weak, although outbound activity produced two meetings. Ryan offered executive support and enterprise proof points, including Anthropic’s usage.

## Keywords
Home Depot, Adobe Target, Enterprise sales pipeline, Proof of concept, CarGurus, Anthropic renewal
